prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: original square World of Warcraft addon logo for Keyring, a minimap-button organizer, part of a collection of richly hand-painted fantasy inventory-item addon icons.
Primary request: one finished square icon of a stout antique brass keyring carrying three chunky enchanted keys. Make the keyring and keys the only hero object, clear and recognisable at 32–64 pixels.
Subject and composition: a thick circular golden brass ring occupies the upper central part, seen at a slight three-quarter angle so it has substantial depth and an open dark centre. Three large old-fashioned keys hang naturally from this ring and spread into a compact downward fan. The foremost, largest key is bright warm gold with a simple sturdy shaft and bold rectangular teeth. The two supporting keys have dark turquoise and emerald enamel accents with broad golden bevels and clearly different tooth profiles. Every key is visibly attached to the shared ring, with mechanically plausible open bows. The ring and the three shafts are easy to distinguish, not fused. No tiny dangling trinkets. Centre the full object, filling approximately 85 percent of the square while keeping all edges visible and a small dark margin. Strong weighty silhouette, few large readable forms, excellent thumbnail contrast.
Style and medium: polished hand-painted fantasy game inventory illustration. Chunky slightly exaggerated geometry, expressive angular brushstrokes, richly textured metal, thick gilded edges, bright sculpted yellow-gold highlights and warm orange shadows. Saturated turquoise and emerald accents, very subtle cool blue rim light. The brushwork must be visibly painterly and detailed, matching an illustrated fantasy tome or battle-shield icon rather than a realistic product render.
Backdrop: full-bleed opaque deep inky midnight-navy square with a restrained blue painterly vignette behind the object. Quiet backdrop, dark corners. No outer decorative frame or rounded tile.
Constraints: one finished icon only, no text, letters, typography, labels, watermark, logo sheet, mockup, UI screenshot, minimap, map pins, drawers, books, shield, flame, wind ribbons, faction crests, character, hands or scenery. No photorealism, glossy 3D render, flat vector style, filigree clutter, chains, padlock, scattered sparkles or huge magical aura. The design should feel like a useful rare-quality Azeroth inventory item, with the warm gold ring and keys dominating.
